correctness.rationale: The four orthogonal H spectral blocks have energies (a+b)(n-1), a(n-1)-b, -a+b(n-1), -a-b; positivity of a,b rules out collisions except the two middle blocks at a=b. Projecting site-diagonal detectors to P⊗P gives n-by-n Gram G=((n-2)/n)I+J/n², eigenvalues (n-1)/n and (n-2)/n, hence rank n for n≥4. Middle blocks contribute 2(n-1) off resonance but only n-1 on resonance; E⊗E contributes one. The H-eigenvector in ker Γ argument identifies this visible spectral space with the entire eventual-loss subspace for every κ_j>0, without requiring equal rates. Independent direct projector construction in scope05_independent_checks.py checked n=4,5,6,7, every diagonal/off-diagonal localized pair and normalized symmetric/antisymmetric pairs, ranks 3n-1 and 2n. Derived v*G^{-1}v and exchange cross terms agree with all printed probabilities. Finite test corroboration is not the n-uniform proof.
